relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain EMM Cause IE

When attempt counter < 5, UE starts timer T3411

When attempt counter = 5 for certain UE modes, UE starts timer T3402
When attempt counter = 5, UE deletes LAI, TMSI and ciphering key sequence number
